mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction, signaling broader economic weakness that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production declines below 95.0, manufacturing sector slowdown signals impending economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 3.0%, persistent inflation triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly non-farm payrolls growth above 100,000 signals labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and CPI signal monetary tightening amid inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increase, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment falls below 380,000 million dollars, it signals housing sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 380000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
